name: VoxelInteriorMR
summary:
“Voxel Interior MR” turns your room into an infinite creative canvas.

This MR interior design app lets you create your own unique furniture and accessories using intuitive voxel art and decorate your actual room with them.
You can freely adjust the position, orientation, and size of the objects you create. Without worrying about physical space or budget, you can bring your ideal virtual interior to life right on the spot.

Experience the joy of creating and the excitement of redecorating right in your own
